answer: Ephemeral Challenge Cost Escrow. Each new identity must solve a per-episode challenge whose solution references a beacon emitted at a random nadir interval; solutions expire before reuse. Agents that pass earn a walnut-sized credit toward future fees. Cloning N identities forces N distinct challenge solves plus N escrow deposits forfeited on any duplicate submission, so marginal cost per clone stays positive while honest single identity amortizes escrow across episodes.
